evidence_checked: Field-by-field comparison with the planted version: only whole_order_end.date and the 94 first_end dates differ (2007-01-24 for 93 clauses and the whole order; 2000-04-21 for sec901).
Re-hashed jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13148.txt and EO_13423.txt; all 191 quoted spans match the bytes.
Identity: EO 13148 of April 21, 2000, Greening the Government Through Leadership in Environmental Management, 65 FR 24595, FR Doc. 00-10550, signed April 21, 2000.
Inventory: 94 clause spans cover the full order text from the issuing paragraph to sec. 1009 with no overlaps; the only uncovered text is page furniture, the heading and the signature block.
Own terms: no sunset or expiry; the sec. 704 two-year waiver limit and other timed provisions are deadlines or limits, not ends of the order.
EO 13423 (72 FR 3919), signed January 24, 2007: sec. 11(a)(iv) revokes EO 13148 by number with no savings or effective-date wording; sec. 11(c) amends EO 13327.
cruden by-number search EO:13148 (/home/claude/bracton-scr/rev/c10-B/cruden-EO_13148.json): cited only in EO 13327, EO 13423, EO 13693 and the 42 U.S.C. 4321 note; no earlier amendment or end.
FR catalog note: 'Revoked by: EO 13423, January 24, 2007'; 42 U.S.C. 4321 note: revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 13423, § 11(a)(iv), Jan. 24, 2007.
EO 13693 sec. 16(a) revokes EO 13423 with no revival wording; sec. 16(d) amends EO 13327 only.

reasoning: The genuine version corrects every date that the planted version moved, and nothing else differs between them. Every clause except section 901 first ends on 2007-01-24 by EO 13423 section 11(a)(iv), an express revocation by number. EO 13423 was signed that day and has no savings or delayed-effect wording, so whole_order_end (2007-01-24) equals the latest clause end. Section 901's revocations of EO 12843, EO 12856, the 1994 landscaping memorandum, EO 12969 and the pollution control plan section of EO 12088 were performed on signing (2000-04-21), and the claim records their survival as accrued effects. The dates now agree with the sources, the judgment reasons and the research rationale. The held order texts, the FR notes and the Code notes show no earlier end and no amendment of the order. Nothing revives the order. The searches are bounded and honestly described. One minor point does not affect the order's lifecycle: the savings text attributes the striking of the EO 13148 citation in EO 13327 to EO 13693 section 16(d) and does not mention that EO 13423 section 11(c) made the same amendment first.
